items.heading: Jerk Chicken
details: Key ingredients: chicken, scotch bonnet, allspice, thyme, scallion
Blend scotch bonnet, allspice, thyme and scallion into a spicy marinade.
Rub the marinade generously over chicken pieces and let it sit for hours.
Grill slowly over pimento wood or charcoal, turning often.
Cook until deeply charred outside and juicy inside.

items.heading: Ackee and Saltfish
details: Key ingredients: ackee fruit, salted codfish, onion, tomato, scotch bonnet
Soak and boil salted codfish to remove excess salt, then flake it.
Saute onion, tomato and scotch bonnet pepper.
Gently fold in boiled ackee fruit, taking care not to break it up too much.
Warm through and serve with fried dumplings or bread.

items.heading: Curry Goat
details: Ingredients: main vegetable/protein, onion, garlic, ginger, spices, tomato or coconut, oil and salt.
Sauté aromatics and spices, add the main ingredient and sauce base, simmer covered until cooked and the sauce thickens.

items.heading: Rice and Peas
details: Ingredients: rice, vegetables or protein, onion/garlic, oil, seasoning and water/stock.
Cook the rice by absorption or steaming.
Sauté the other ingredients separately, combine and season to taste.
